✴️ Skill Tree

Drag to pan · pinch or scroll to zoom. The dense inner hub mixes ⬥ hybrid nodes (mana + dodge, tile-break gold, cheaper class skills) with stats and colour damage. The wedges between neighbouring arms are threaded with interstitial lattices: twin colour-shift spurs, cross-webs to both keystone spokes and hybrid gates, so every gap is a route. Beyond each ★ keystone, five outer tiers branch into supplemental passives and end in ♛ Master capstones that rewrite the rules. Tap an allocated node to refund it for gold, or respec the whole tree.

GEMGRIND
Match. Level. Conquer the world.
Difficulty
Swap or swipe gems to match 3 or more. Colours charge your skills and skulls hurt enemies. Every cascade multiplies damage and resources (×2, ×3, ×4) and charges your next skill. Match 4+ in a row for an extra turn. Casting a skill launches your class projectile at the enemy and spends your turn, as does drinking a potion. Your mana starts at 0 in every new battle. Special gems: 4 in a line forges a ⚡ Striped Gem that lasers its row or column, a T or L of 5 forges a 💥 Wrapped Gem that blasts 3×3 twice, and 5 in a line forges a 🌈 Runic Catalyst that detonates every gem of one colour. Swap two power-ups into each other for a MEGA-COMBO: Striped + Striped fires a cross-laser, Striped + Wrapped a 3-wide mega-cross, Wrapped + Wrapped a 5×5 double blast, Catalyst + power-up converts a colour into copies and chain-detonates them, and Catalyst + Catalyst wipes the board at a flat ×5 combo. Emerald matches cleanse Burning, Poison and frozen tiles. Elite enemies inflict ailments, and continent bosses reshape the board every 3 turns and become ENRAGED after 15 of your turns: skulls hit twice as hard and the burning board scorches you every round. After each fight your hero walks the road to the next city. Every 3 nodes the sky shifts between Torchlit Dusk, Midnight Obsidian and Bloodmoon Crimson, each boosting a different gathering skill. ⛺ Campsites let you cook 3 fish for a full heal. Fund projects in the 🔬 Research Lab with gold, materials and Gold Shards from salvaged junk. Use ⏩ to speed up combat ×1 / ×2 / ×3. Your layered Hero Inventory, the Skill Tree, skills, shop, quests and shards all live in the 🎒 Character Console. Hotkeys: 1–4 cast skills, P opens potions, Esc pauses. Every class has a signature skill: Rending Slash, Frost Nova, Envenom, Turn Undead, Snare Trap, Blood Sacrifice and Shield Bash. Defeat never costs you anything: your gold, shards, materials and gear stay safe, and you walk away with a small consolation purse of XP and gold.
